tasks.title: Expose derivatives in source and boot inspection
tasks.goal: Connect exact derivative provenance to source queries and debugger views.
steps: Consume the accepted M-06-C and M-01 contracts to resolve a derivative resource as its own identity with full provenance.
Add base/local/result relationships to actual boot occurrences and source/raw-projection navigation without inventing a second compiler.
Verify same-snapshot paging and exact contribution attribution after a derivative update; stale captures remain explicit.
positive_cases: Source query and debugger navigate the same base→local→result records.
A repeated inclusion keeps distinct occurrences while sharing exact payload identity.
negative_cases: A stale derivative cannot be labeled current source-proven.
Opening a view cannot recompute effectful derivatives or invoke providers.

tasks.title: Prove derivative activation, revocation and recovery
tasks.goal: Deliver the full active-resource path under new authority and retained artifact/receipt ownership.
steps: Produce a code-bearing derivative fixture and publish its exact artifact through the existing artifact/adapter machinery.
Prepare and issue a new exact activation grant; exercise apply/update/verify/remove and a base/local change between plan and effect.
Revoke the descriptor/grant and inspect/clean up using retained host-readable ownership; retain partial status on interruption.
positive_cases: Explicitly admitted derivative activation works and preserves neighboring state.
Revoked or missing descriptor remains inspectable and safely removable under new cleanup authority.
negative_cases: Changed result, inherited grant or drifted receipt refuses without guessing rollback.
